metaDescription: Order custom full color multi function tools for your next promotion. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration on multi function tools gives you the ability to reproduce logos, photos, or intricate designs with vivid detail. Unlike single-color imprints, full color allows for gradients and fine text that stand out on tools like the Laser Level With 8' Tape Measure. This is ideal for marketing directors who want to showcase complex branding or safety managers distributing memorable giveaways at trade shows. The result is a premium look that reinforces your message every time the tool is used.
heroAltText: Custom full color multi function tools with detailed logo imprint on a laser level and tape measure
